purpose: Player-level review only, no forecasts/settings changed
ranking: Severity then largest absolute delta divided by existing v1.31 review threshold; separate substantial-volume list >=200 PA or >=100 projected IP. Ranking is triage, not talent/confidence.
sparse: Prior MLB paired AB<200 or OUTS<300
short_stint: A season with <50 minor PA or <60 minor OUTS plus >=400 prior MLB PA or >=300 OUTS in prior four years; candidate for rehab review, not confirmation
role_mix: At least five games and 60 OUTS, GS/G >=.5 starter, GS=0 reliever, otherwise swing; source recent minor vs latest eligible MLB role
normalization_diagnostic: Hold original MLB-only mean recency weight fixed in a counterfactual, without fitting, tuning or replacing predictions; attribute pre-coherence difference only
metadata: Exact MLBAM or unambiguous observed FanGraphs-ID bridge. No name-only injury/roster joins. Snapshots are undated unless dates explicitly supplied.
